name: Butyl glycolate
description: Butyl glycolate (CAS 7397-62-8 ), also known as butyl hydroxyacetate, is a glycolic acid ester used as a solvent and surface-active agent across coatings, adhesives, and personal care formulations. It combines moderate polarity with good solvency, making it effective for dissolving resins and modifying surface behavior in industrial systems. In coatings and printing inks, it functions as a coalescing solvent. This material acts as a wetting agent, improving film formation and substrate adhesion on difficult surfaces. Adhesive and sealant formulators incorporate it to adjust viscosity and enhance bonding performance. In personal care, it is used as a carrier solvent in leave-on and rinse-off formulations where controlled delivery of active ingredients is required. Packaging ink manufacturers also use it to improve pigment dispersion. The compound helps ensure high print quality on plastic substrates. It is supplied as a clear liquid in standard industrial packaging, including drums and IBC containers for bulk distribution. Technical grade is the primary commercial specification available for industrial and coatings applications. Personal care and cosmetic applications typically require material meeting higher purity standards. Buyers should confirm grade suitability with the supplier prior to procurement. The product is handled according to standard safety protocols for industrial esters to ensure stability and performance. Contact us for supply of Butyl glycolate Request Quote
